limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade validation of the match

matched_base_amount.meaning: base amount of the matched limit order
matched_base_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade validation of the match

matched_quote_amount.meaning: quote amount of the matched limit order

matched_amounts_bitwise_and.meaning: bitwise AND of matched base amount and matched quote amount (zero iff no overlapping 1-bits)

zero_cost_trade_reverted.meaning: the legitimate limit order match reverted with ZeroCostTrade()

assumptions: The matched base and quote amounts are nonzero for a legitimate trade, as stated by the intent source.
The zero-cost trade validation is the check that can revert with ZeroCostTrade() during the match.
